dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: There are many kinds of hot springs here. Don't wander off into the wrong one!

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: Ah, the main difference is the temperature. The artificial hot springs we built for the tourists are usually quite a bit cooler, so it won't be a problem even if you were to soak in there for a whole day.

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: Compared to that, there are far less ways to control the temperature of the natural pools. Usually, you'll only find the heat-loving Koholasaurs playing in there.

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: Of course, there are always those who love the top temps, or just want to challenge themselves. You can sometimes find those "experts" swimming with the Saurians.

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: I have a lot of respect for them, but what they do is not for the faint of heart... and definitely not for outlanders.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do many outlanders come to take a dip?

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: Hmm, I'd say a lot? Most tourists enjoy their time here, and since they're already here, might as well enjoy a dip in the hot springs.

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: I remember a gentleman who came here from Inazuma. He would have spent every hour of every day in the hot springs if he could... It always took me a lot of effort to drag him out of the pool.

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: He even wrote me a letter after going back home. He said he'd opened a hot spring hotel in Inazuma, and even invited me to come.

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I can't just leave Natlan willy-nilly... Otherwise, I'd have loved to check out what he's done.

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: Hmm? You mean something more stimulating for the skin and muscles? Can't quite imagine that...

dialogues.speaker: Mataoho
dialogues.text: But based on your description, you might need to eat something to restore stamina after soaking in that.
